<div class="card-body">
'''Tatooine: Cantina''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン：カンティーナ（酒場）</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここにいるエイリアンにそれぞれ没収値＋１。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">タスケン・レイダーを除く、ここにいるエイリアンにそれぞれ戦闘力＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-290o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tatooine: Cantina.

'''Light Side:''' Each alien here is forfeit +1.

'''Dark Side:''' Each alien here except Tusken Raiders is power +1.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese applies to each alien here; English applies to your aliens.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tatooine: Cantina (Dark)|Tatooine: Cantina]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
